description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API endpoints related to employee timesheet items within the Time module.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetItemAPITest
classes.description: A test suite for the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class, covering typical CRUD operations (mostly expecting not implemented exceptions) and fetching all items with different test cases.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all employee timesheet items via the API, using data provider for multiple test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testGetAll method, reading from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create method in the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule retrieval for create throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee timesheet item through the API, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the testUpdate method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method in the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule retrieval for delete throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Ensures that the getOne method in the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Ensures that the validation rule retrieval for getOne throws a not implemented exception.
